name: Transcaribe
body: A declared language, a canonical, a sitemap index in robots.txt, a 301 to https, and GA4. But 19 pages analyzed use a positive tabindex, which pulls one element ahead of everything else in keyboard order.
lesson: Use tabindex="0" or "-1" only. Fix focus order by ordering the HTML, not with positive numbers.
summary: transcaribe.gov.co scores 74 out of 100 (C). 3 checks fail now, 24 are at risk, and 18 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 19 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 10 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /index.php/politicas-de-seguridad-digital/, /index.php/politicas/, /index.php/plan-de-reasentamiento/, /index.php/plan-de-ocupantes-de-espacio-publico/ and 1 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 19 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: 19 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /, /index.php/rutas-sitm/, /index.php/red_de_recarga/, /index.php/historia/ and 15 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: 1 session cookie is readable by scripts
fix.evidence: Without HttpOnly: ep_session_id. A script injected into the page could steal the session. Set on /index.php/gestion-ambiental/, /index.php/politicas-de-seguridad-digital/, /index.php/politicas/ and 3 more.
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

fix.title: X-Content-Type-Options is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers may guess a file's type and run it as script. Missing on all 19 pages analyzed.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
Structured data parses and carries the expected properties
